newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's economic expansion to slow down -- EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan's economic expansion to slow down -- EPA.

text.p: Japan's economic expansion will slow down in the latter half of this fiscal year, although the recovery trend will remain in place, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Vice Minister Shinpei Nukaya said on Friday.

"Although we can't avoid seeing the pace of economic expansion slowing down in the latter half of the fiscal year, it is not the kind of slowdown that would threaten the economic recovery trend," Nukaya told a regular news conference.
He added that at the moment, there was no need for a large-scale supplementary budget.

"Since economic growth in the January to June period was high due to special factors such as the leap-year effect, we cannot avoid a slowdown of economic expansion in the latter half of this fiscal year," he said.
"Gradual recovery is continuing and private-sector demand remains firm...there is no need to come up measures for more large-scale (public) demand," he said.
